💡
Board Stock Ledger Kaise Padhein?
Is ledger me 77x98x190 size ka poora movement dikhta hai — kitni sheets mill se aayi (Inward), kitni printing ke liye gayi aur covers ban kar wapas aayi (info rows), aur production me kul 0 Sheets consume hui. Stock left har row ke baad Closing column me chalta hai (0 Sheets) — Lal (Deficit) matlab requirement se zyada use ho chuka hai.
Kya-Kya Dikhta Hai:
  • Board Inward — mill/challan se raw sheets received
  • Sent to Printer — printing ke liye bheji gayi (info row, total stock pe koi effect nahi)
  • Printed Covers Received — printer se covers wapas (info row, total stock pe koi effect nahi)
  • Production Consumed — barcode-wise notebook production me sheets use hui

💡
WIP Negative / Shortage Kyu Aaya?
Factory me Unruled Notebooks ka Production log kiya gaya hai jisme kul 0 Kg paper consume hua. Lekin factory inventory me is ruling ke Cut Sheets ki Opening Stock enter nahi thi (ya Reel Slitting Entry pass nahi hui thi), is wajah se stock negative (-0 Kg) show ho raha hai.
Ise Theek Kaise Karein?
  • Agar reels se cutting ho chuki hai, to niche "Log Reel Cutting Entry" button dabayein aur sheets add karein.
  • Agar factory me physical cut sheets pehle se uplabdh thi, to "Set Opening Cut Sheets" button dabakar initial stock fill karein.
